scope.storage: Intact private local wallet cohort across process/native restarts and coherent app-update directory relocation with SDK envelope version 2

qualificationLimits: Fault injection covers recorded storage/native boundaries and native restart; physical power loss and SIGKILL at every boundary are not established by these tests.
Configured VSS is rejected by all four durable native APIs and by SDK command construction and recovery actions.
Full ZIP restore, selective file loss, reconstructed empty outboxes and mixed-age app/native snapshots are unsupported; absence is not a rejection certificate across such restores.
Legacy unidentified one-shot attempts remain protected and cannot be resolved by matching similar history.
Unpublished path-bound SDK envelope version 1 is not silently migrated to stable-identity version 2; it remains strictly bound to its original path and request.
Consumers must preserve a wallet-wide unresolved-operation guard and must not mix legacy one-shot sends or other wallet mutations into a pending recoverable operation. Aster enforces this guard.
Settled operation and tombstone retention is not capacity qualified; new preparation scans retained records and no automatic pruning is permitted.
Simulator qualification does not establish device, Intel Simulator, Android, signed distribution, public native provenance or production-mainnet readiness.
remainingReleaseGates: Complete required iOS RGB end-to-end, physical-device and Android qualification; Android builds were explicitly deferred.
Establish approved native provenance and publish matching qualified artifacts with an immutable SDK revision.
Update Aster's immutable SDK dependency and verify a clean public dependency restore without local overrides.
Define and qualify supported backup/restore continuity before claiming recovery across restore.
Establish retention, capacity and migration policy without reviving rejected or settled operation IDs.
Complete existing security, release configuration and funds-bearing mainnet release gates.

verificationAppliesTo.note: The funded host and iOS runtime evidence above belongs to the earlier immutable stable-wallet-v2 candidate. It must not be presented as a fresh runtime test of later source or app changes.

changes: Typed, payload-free native preparation rejection reasons preserve phase and End-authorization certainty.
After a native timeout, identity and exact durable status remain serialized behind native completion and cannot lift mutation quarantine or resubmit payment.
All durable APIs move blocking wallet/HTTP operations onto blocking workers with an owned lifecycle guard; cancelling the waiter does not cancel work or let shutdown overtake it.
